target_customer: Consumer brands and agencies that buy sponsored content from social media creators and influencers
problem: Brands found it slow and manual to find, brief, pay and measure influencers and creators for content campaigns.
business_model: Marketplace and managed campaigns with a take rate on creator payouts plus a brand dashboard

founders.name: Corbett Drummey
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CEO, says Popular Pays was acquired by Lightricks, and notes Forbes 30 Under 30 in 2018 and a later co-founded company, Brill Neurotech (2025). Prior employers and education are not on the YC page; a search snippet said he was a former Leo Burnett account executive but the article was not opened, so it is not recorded.

founders.name: Steven Wanderski
founders.background_notes: Listed as a founder on the YC page; no bio given.

competitors.name: FameBit
competitors.what: Marketplace connecting brands with YouTube creators, expanding to Vine, Instagram and Twitter in late 2015
competitors.traction_then: About 15,000 YouTube creators with 650 million subscribers by Aug 2015

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace plus iOS app and brand dashboard with payments and campaign stats. Standard engineering for a small team in 2015, no research risk.

defensibility.rationale: Two sided supply of creators gave some pull, but several marketplaces and agencies offered the same service and creators multi-home.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms did not kill the category; Popular Pays stayed independent, broke even in 2016 per press, and was sold to Lightricks in March 2022.

market_need_then: Brand spend on social content and influencers was growing in 2015 and brands lacked tooling to source and pay creators at scale; evidence is secondary press on competitors such as FameBit expanding platforms in 2015.

branding.domain_note: Used popularpays.com; no acquisition story found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; the name is descriptive of the creator payout promise but little evidence it drove awareness.

outcome_analysis: Popular Pays sold creator content campaigns to brands from Chicago, raised roughly 11 to 13 million dollars over three disclosed rounds, reportedly broke even in 2016, and was acquired by Lightricks in March 2022 as its entry into B2B creator marketing. The price was reported only as tens of millions by one outlet and is unconfirmed.
notes: Company website fetch failed (header overflow error), not a dead site confirmation. Round stages for 2017 and 2018 are labeled other because press and aggregators disagree (the 2017 money was folded into a 5.2M Series A per press; aggregators call 2018 a Series B). Aggregator totals: CB Insights 12.58M. The Lightricks price (tens of millions, Calcalist headline) is unverified. Two aggregators list a 200K seed in 2013, unverified. No branding source found for name origin.
